name: AsterPay

overview.text: AsterPay presents x402/MPP facilitation, agent-wallet trust scoring and stablecoin-to-EUR bank payouts. Its readiness checker and sample receipt are product interfaces/illustrations. EUR pricing is 0.5% plus EUR0.10, called per payout in the headline but per settled transaction in FAQ. Facilitation starts at EUR0.001/call with high-volume monthly plans; data APIs separately list $0.0015-$0.15 USDC/call. Free reads/keyless payments do not imply anonymous bank payout: production EUR settlement needs approved KYB and a bank account. Base, Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum and Optimism support varies by token; EURCV is listed on Ethereum, EURC on Base/Ethereum. Lightning is separate; Solana, XRPL, Monad and GBP payouts are roadmap. The operator calls itself a technical provider using licensed European partners; MiCA-aligned is not independent licence verification. Speed/compliance claims and KYA scores do not guarantee identity, safety or refunds. Escrow thresholds conflict below 70 versus below 30. Privacy terms cover KYB/transaction records, immutable chain data, logs and human review of consequential automated decisions.

disclosure: Source: listed on YourAITools (youraitools.co, CC BY 4.0), verified by Commonworld unpaid 402 probe 2026-10-23 (23:09-23:11 UTC). No payment, deal or contact with AsterPay or YourAITools is involved.
